decisions.text: type bumps: changes in rank are the point (06 DP6-1): a bumps chart
a rank scale, 1 at the top to 10 at the bottom, one label per rank, “Rank” above them (G7.24)

each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the final ranks: Norway slot 1, Germany slot 2, Canada slot 3, United States slot 4, Netherlands slot 5, South Korea slot 6, Russia slot 7, Switzerland slot 8, France slot 9, Sweden slot 10
each line drawn with curves flat at every point, so that it never overshoots the ranks it joins (G7.17, G7.24)
each line labelled at its right end, at its final rank, so the labels read in final-rank order (G7.24)
no gridlines: the rank numbers stand beside each row, and the lines are read by their order (G7.24)
the title wraps onto two lines
